title: λ Andromedae, CHARA/MIRC calibrated visibilities of six nights of September 2011, as shipped with ROTIR.jl

evidence.locator: Six files 2011Sep02 to 2011Sep24 .lam_And_prepped.oifits under demos/data at the pinned commit, read by demos/lam_and_reconstruction.jl there; their numbers of squared visibilities match Parks et al. (2021), Table 1.

statements.text: CHARA Array/MIRC, September 2011, as calibrated by the authors of Parks et al. (2021) and Martinez et al. (2021) and shipped with ROTIR.jl (F. Baron)
